Name Foresail-2
Spacecraft type CubeSat
Units or mass 6U
Status not launched, expected in 2028
Launcher not launched
Organisation Finnish Centre of Excellence for Sustainable Space
Institution Institute
Entity type Government (Civil / Military)
Headquarters Finland
Partners University of Helsinki, Aalto University, University of Turku, Finnish Meteorological Institute (FMI)
Oneliner

CubeSat to GTO with tether for Coulomb Drag Experiment and measuring radiation in the Van Allen belts.
Description

Support ULF plasma wave modeling in Vlasiator. Coulomb Drag Experiment (CDE): Deploying a long charged tether; measuring ambient plasma density, and the strength of Coulomb drag in different plasma densities. Relativistic Electron and Proton Experiment (REPE): Measuring electron and proton spectra, to monitor the dynamics of the most penetrating radiation in the Van Allen belts Magnetic field measurements
